caption: The drawing depicts a metallic pitcher with a tall, cylindrical body that features a prominent diagonal, spiral ridge running from the base to the neck. The pitcher is rendered in shades of gray and silver, indicating a reflective metal surface. The base is wide and rounded, narrowing slightly as it ascends. The lid is domed, with a knob at the top center, and a decorative fluted pattern. The handle is attached at the top and curves outward and downward, connecting near the lower half of the pitcher, with a small protruding thumb rest. The background of the drawing is a plain off-white or beige color, with irregular light brown stains or blotches in several locations around the pitcher and some faint smudges. The lower right corner contains a handwritten signature that reads "Suzanne Chapman."
title: Pewter Pitcher
